categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Touches src/txmempool.h only to add a one-line count accessor; this is a mechanical edit following directly from the RPC change.
categories.rationale: The change to CTxMemPool is solely a mechanical accessor added to support an RPC optimization without altering mempool behavior or policy.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies src/rpc/mempool.cpp to optimize MempoolInfoToJSON.
categories.rationale: Avoids copying the entire unbroadcast transaction ID set under lock when calling getmempoolinfo. While unbroadcast sets are typically small, author microbenchmarks demonstrate this eliminates query scaling up to ~0.9 ms at 10,000 entries.
